Subject: Quick: 30m intro for Product Manager role — a few timezone-aware options

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for applying to the Product Manager role at Redwood Inference. I’d love to set up a quick 30-minute phone screen so we can learn more about your background and walk through the role. A couple of notes up front:

- The hiring manager (Laura) will join for ~15 minutes.
- We know Europe/US timezones are tricky — below are windows that work for us (we’re on PST). If none fit, send a few of yours and we’ll adapt.

Available windows (PST):
• Tue 12/22: 12:30–14:30 PST (20:30–22:30 CET)
• Wed 12/23: 08:00–11:00 PST (16:00–19:00 CET)
• Thu 12/24: 12:00–13:30 PST (20:00–21:30 CET) — happy to keep it short if you’re traveling.

If you confirm a slot, I’ll send a calendar invite (Google Calendar + .ics). I’ve attached a one-pager with the role and a short hiring timeline.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Talent Partner | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0198
Attachments: RD-ProductManager-brief.pdf (1 page role brief)

- My phone: +34 612 345 678.
